description: A/A test - both arms receive the existing checkout
reasons: Primary difference -1.16 pp, p=0.092; an A/A test is expected to be non-significant 95% of the time.

description: Simplified checkout is faster but does not change purchase completion
reasons: Inconclusive: -0.24 pp (95% CI -1.59 to +1.11) is consistent with no effect and with a worthwhile lift (>= 1.0 pp). Not evidence of no effect. Next step: a new, pre-registered test sized for the smallest lift still worth launching - not an extension of this one. Guardrails not cleared: net_order_value_per_user, checkout_error_rate, cancellation_rate.

description: Simplified checkout raises completion by 2.5 pp and reduces errors
reasons: Primary improved: +2.07 pp (95% CI +0.73 to +3.41); estimate >= 1.0 pp. All guardrails within margins.
